sections.content: Dark mode via prefers-color-scheme media query + custom properties is the clean approach: define semantic tokens (--bg, --surface, --text) and flip them per scheme.
Manual toggles need a data-theme attribute + :root[data-theme="dark"] overrides, persisted in localStorage. Either way, never hardcode colors — always go through variables.
Key points: pure black backgrounds cause halation — use dark grays, images need dark variants, and test contrast in both modes.
